title: Enemy Type Definition
description: Semantic source of truth for an enemy type. The web enemy type editor and the JSON->C compiler both read this; it must not be edited by hand except through the editor.

id.description: Unique identifier for this enemy type (lowercase, underscores only).

category.description: Enemy category for battle screen filtering.

sprite.description: Battle-sprite art selection. Null = text fallback (no battle art). Otherwise names an art set from assets/battle_sprites.png (see ART_SETS in battle_compile.py) rendered as 3x2 background tiles in battle.

art.description: Art-set id; must exist in the compiler's ART_SETS table.

frames.description: Animation frames (2 = alternate top row, e.g. slime mouth; 1 = static).

overworld.description: Shared overworld OAM sprite (one sprite for every world; the sheet background maps to transparent). Absent/null = legacy SPRITE_KIND rendering. cells is a flat frame-major list of width*height*frames tile names: a 1x1 sprite uses one tile per frame (2 cells = 2 animation frames), a 2x2 sprite uses four tiles per frame (4 cells = 1 frame).

width.description: Overworld sprite width in tiles (default 1). A 2x2 boss uses width 2.

height.description: Overworld sprite height in tiles (default 1). A 2x2 boss uses height 2.

cells.description: Compose-layout tile names (tools/compose_enemy_sprites.py LAYOUT); width*height*frames entries, frame-major (frame0's width*height cells, then frame1's, ...).

anyOf.description: OBJ ramp name from assets/palette.txt (preferred; the editor writes names).

palette.description: CGB OAM palette: an OBJ ramp name (preferred) or a legacy hardware slot index.

name.description: Display name shown in battle UI (e.g., 'SLIME').

hp.description: Base HP for this enemy type.

max_hp.description: Base maximum HP for this enemy type.

battle_id.description: Engine battle ID constant (e.g., BATTLE_SLIME, BATTLE_BOSS).

ai_types.description: Valid AI types for this enemy type.

reward_currency.description: Currency ID granted on defeat (e.g., CURRENCY_ID_GOLD).
